title: Line Winder Aluminum – Quick Line Change on the Reel
descriptionHtml:
New line on the reel: a stick between your knees and an hour of your life

Anyone who has changed fishing line themselves knows the feeling – the line twists, the tension gets uneven and half the job has to be redone.

The solution: even tension, straight wraps, done in minutes

A line winder in aluminum alloy that holds the spool steady while you crank on the new line – even, tight and tangle-free. The most tedious part of fishing, solved once and for all.

Features

  • Line change in minutes – no tangles
  • No loose wraps – even line tension all the way
  • Fits most spools and reels
  • Handles water – aluminum alloy
  • Goes in the fishing bag – compact

Change of mind
